asset.title: Aqara Makes Canadian Retail Debut with Canadian Tire, Expanding Access to Smart Home Technology Nationwide

contentAttributes.summary: TORONTO, October 09, 2026--Aqara, a global leader in IoT today announced its Canadian retail debut through a new partnership with Canadian Tire. Starting October 9, a selection of Aqara smart home products will be available in upwards of 500 Canadian Tire locations nationwide, marking a significant milestone in Aqara’s expansion across North America.
